title: The Chaplain's Commutation
logline: A weary station chaplain seeks compassionate release for a dying convict, unaware the wealthy donor funding the hospice ward was the convict's old accomplice and will pay anything to keep him silenced.

roles.description: Tends to convicts aboard the penal hulk; gentle, weary, troubled by the weight of confessions.
Endowed the prison medical wing; outwardly a righteous patron of justice, privately terrified of exposure.
A decommissioned freighter converted into an orbital penal chapel and palliative ward.
The administrative station module where judicial petitions and medical commutations are ratified.

public_situation: The orbital parish aboard {role:penal_hulk_parish} has lodged a compassionate release petition with {role:arbitration_chancery} for a terminally ill prisoner.
private_truth: {role:avenging_sponsor} is funding dock delays to keep the prisoner from leaving alive, because the dying man's final confession exposes the sponsor as his former partner in crime.

beats.public_change: The chancery places the commutation petition on the emergency docket with a seventy-two hour filing deadline.

missions.reason: The chaplain hires an uncompromised outside pilot to deliver the sworn medical affidavit and petition before station registrars leave.
missions.private_fact: He discovered a wax-sealed confession cylinder inside the prisoner's prayer book that names the ward's patron.

beats.public_change: {role:avenging_sponsor} registers priority salvage and mooring liens against {role:penal_hulk_parish} to delay clearance.

missions.reason: The sponsor pays the pilot to purchase administrative docket suspension vouchers to push the hearing into next term.
missions.private_fact: He is using shell company credits borrowed against future shipping yields to buy the docket delays.

beats.public_change: Medical monitors from {role:penal_hulk_parish} signal the patient has entered critical organ failure.

missions.reason: The chaplain needs the pilot to retrieve the prisoner's sealed personal testament and confession reliquary from the chapel altar.
missions.private_fact: The chaplain is terrified that exposing the truth will destroy the hospice charity that keeps sixty other inmates alive.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the dying confession. The sponsor offers a massive settlement to burn it, while the chaplain prays for justice without destroying the parish.

options.label: Deliver the confession to the chancery magistrate to force the pardon
Hand the confession cylinder to the sponsor in exchange for his hush money
Compel the sponsor to fund permanent hospice care in exchange for sealing the cylinder

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot submits the confession cylinder directly to the chancery magistrate.
resolutions.summary: The chancery pardons the prisoner and arrests {role:avenging_sponsor}. The dying man spends his final hours in civilian care while the sponsor faces trial.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot brought a dying convict's confession to court, unmasking a pious sponsor as his old partner.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the confession cylinder to the sponsor.
resolutions.summary: {role:avenging_sponsor} burns the confession and enforces the mooring lien. The prisoner dies in the penal ward, and the chaplain loses his faith in the court.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the sponsor to endow the parish hospice in exchange for quiet burial.
resolutions.summary: {role:avenging_sponsor} endows the chapel with permanent life-support funding. The confession is buried unread, and the chaplain carries the secret alone.

consequences.public_summary: Word spread of a substantial anonymous bequest that saved an orbital prison chapel from closing.

resolutions.reached_by: Filings are delayed or the pilot ignores the contract.
resolutions.summary: The commutation filing deadline lapses while paperwork idles in {role:arbitration_chancery}. The prisoner passes away behind bars without receiving a hearing.

loose_threads.detail: The prayer book contains a pawn promissory note tying {role:avenging_sponsor} to an outer system banking house.
The emergency docket index was altered overnight using administrative clearance credentials belonging to a deceased magistrate.
A scrap speculator acquired future demolition options on {role:penal_hulk_parish} six weeks before the parish petitioned for relief.

radio_hooks: Station registrars in {system} debate proposed revisions to prison compassionate release guidelines.
Donations to orbital medical ministries drop as commercial shipping rates rise across the sector.
Administrative disputes between private sponsors and parish chaplains stall chancery dockets.

voice_direction.prison_chaplain: Quiet, unhurried, long thoughtful pauses between sentences. Chooses words carefully like fragile glassware; avoids using legal terminology.
voice_direction.avenging_sponsor: Forceful, righteous, highly practiced moral outrage. Shifts abruptly to venomous pragmatism whenever financial exposure is raised.
